name: detector-rail-idle
comment: An unpowered detector rail (28) between two rails and a powered one (set_block meta 9), each with a cobblestone EntityItem dropped on it (motion zeroed). Rails have no collision box, so the items land on the stone at y = 61 and Entity.moveEntity calls BlockDetectorRail.onEntityCollidedWithBlock every tick: the unpowered rail runs getEntitiesWithinAABB(EntityMinecart) and finds nothing (no draws, no metadata change, no scheduled tick); the powered one ignores the collision and stays on (no player, so no random tick reaches its updateTick). power dumps the stone under it (strong power, isIndirectlyPoweringTo side 1) and the cell east of it (weak power).
